notes.title: Custom Game Update
notes.notes:
Hello there, so here's an update! The main addition is the Custom Game Menu, so you can replay levels/the full game with weapons/spells/upgrades/gameplay modifiers you've unlocked. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41381250/6f762c669cee98ac2ac38423af99047fffe221e2.png[/img]
To unlock levels you have to finish them in the regular game mode, if you've completed the game already before this update just replay the last save in the last level, finish the game and you'll have all levels unlocked in the Custom Game Menu. If you don't have the next level finished when playing a custom game, you'll be kicked back to the menu upon completion of the current level. You can also enable a cheat menu, so if you pause the game you have access to a menu to give weapons/ammo/spells/health/mana etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41381250/f4e608124304024127cc15a2fcbabf795d544ee3.png[/img]

As well as this a bunch of bug fixes and gameplay balances are in. Notably:

[list]
[*] Super shotgun upgrades carry between levels now
[*] Saves made at the start of a level are now separate and aren't saved over at save shrines
[*] Siphon mana spell gives the player more mana
[*] Weapon numbers can now be bound in the key rebinds menu
[*] Spells now have quick switch buttons (F1-F6 by default, can be rebound)
[*] Added a quick-switch button to change to the previously selected spell (Z by default)
[*] Crossbow now does higher damage to armored enemies
[*] Pyre spell particles have increased, making it easier to burn enemies
[/list]

notes.title: A new update (gameplay balance, bug fixing and steam achievements)
notes.notes:
Hey, just another update. The biggest change is the addition of Steam achievements. Along with this comes changes to gameplay balance:

[list]
[*]Crossbow cripples enemies more easily
[*]Crossbow does more damage to armored enemies 
[*]Beekeeper health has been greatly reduced
[*]Bees can be burnt easier with the pyre spell
[*]More ammo has been added, specifically special ammo (poison bolts, nailbombs etc.)
[*]Added more secrets to the castle level
[/list]

Also made a bunch of bug fixes, too many to list. As always if you find anything posting on the bug thread on the steam forums is a great help 🙏

Merry christmas! Enjoy!

notes.title: Changing the release date
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

So aye I'll be changing the release date from Halloween this year for Early Access to "when it's done" basically. Working full time and then on Coven in my spare time has gotten to be a bit problematic in terms of having a life and not being burnt out constantly. If I could drop my day job and just work on Coven I would of course but bills have to be paid ːsteamfacepalmː

The delay won't be too long, not like a year or anything. Most likely release in the first half of next year, possibly earlier. Just wanted to let you all know so you're not disappointed on Halloween when there's no release. 

The original plan was to just crunch and pretty much not sleep for a couple months to get it out for Halloween but I've decided against that for two reasons. One being that I'd most certainly end up burnt out and going into early access already burnt out isn't great for me or the game. The second reason is that I don't think the quality would have been up to the standard that I want it to be if I was to work under those conditions and I'd really want the game to release in the best state possible even if it's an early access release.

So... The first episode will be out before summer next year, not 100% on when. It could be earlier in the year or closer to summer. We shall see. 

- The first episode will consist of 10 levels set in the 1600's (at latest Summer 2024 release)
- The second episode will consist of another 10 or so levels set not too long after the first but in a different place entirely, so the general vibe and colour palette will be different. Will include new spells and weapons. (Q4 2024)
- The third episode will be set hundreds of years in the future and again consist of around 6-8 levels. Will combine old weapons from the first episodes with a bunch of newer modern weapons. (2025 release)

That's the road map for now. Thankfully with the way I've set up the gameplay systems, adding new weapons/spells and making changes to the player abilities isn't a massive ordeal so I can change things up and improve the gameplay while I make new levels. It's still quite a lot of work of course but certainly manageable. I've also been toying with releasing some interlude levels as well, which would be the odd standalone level here and there in between bigger releases to flesh out the universe and just give people some more Coven to play while they wait for the next episode. 

Again, sorry for the delay but in the end it will make the game better and keep my mental health from falling into oblivion ːhuntedː
